top.en: Seeing BLG destroy T1's nexus, the feeling was indescribable. Tears just streamed down my face—I didn't expect that. In the domestic league, due to various circumstances, I wasn't really a fan of some BLG players. I like Knight and ON, but that's it; I'm an IG fan, I've been watching them since 2017. Before the match, I didn't even set an alarm. I didn't know if I wanted BLG to beat T1 because I was afraid of the [~0:reckoning] and didn't want IG to be mocked, but I wanted the LPL to win. With that mindset, it was the first time this Worlds that I didn't set an alarm, but my biological clock woke me up anyway. From game one, my heart was tied to BLG, and I realized I wanted them to win for the LPL. When they won, I was shaking all over; I think I've started to like BLG too. This is Bin's third Worlds. Like the King of Yue [~1:swallowing Wu], Bin, after two Worlds failures, has risen up to beat GEN and become the champion who sweeps the bracket—the true best top laner in the world!

notes.context: Refers to fans being mocked or 'settled scores' with by rival fans after their team loses.
A historical idiom about the King of Yue enduring humiliation to eventually defeat his rival, Wu.

真拿你没办法，坐好了，那是S赛的舞台，一场足以让整个LPL长出一口气的破壁之夜。场馆万众屏息，红蓝交错，喧嚣与沉寂反复更迭，每一次开团、每一回拉扯，都是破除心魔路上最滚烫的注脚。十三场S赛连败，像十三道旧疤，压在LPL对T1的漫长记忆里；无数次开局有梦、终局有憾，命运一次次把“恐T1”三个字推到LPL面前。

BLG不是没有经历过质疑。失误、被逆转、关键局手软，那些声音他们都听过。可这一次，褪去急躁与犹疑，他们沉稳笃定，没有花哨的侥幸，唯有千锤百炼的配合与背水一战的果断。每一次架线坚守，都是重压之下的担当；每一次果断开团，都是不甘旧憾的抗争。

整场对决胶着拉扯、惊心动魄，比分交替攀升，局势反复反转，所有人都在等一个结局。当最后一波团战在T1高地上尘埃落定，当终局水晶爆裂的音效响彻场馆，所有焦灼与坚守终有归宿。十三连败，至此终结；心魔高墙，轰然倒塌。

这不是一场普通的胜利。这是BLG把LPL在S赛面对T1的旧账，亲手翻到了最后一页；是多年压抑尽数释然，是长久奔赴终得回响。赛场欢呼炸裂，聚光灯尽数落下，昔日的魔咒，终于成了破壁的注脚。

一局一念，年年破壁。这不止是BLG的凯旋，更是LPL把“恐T1”从S赛史册上划掉的一夜，让所有踏过的荆棘、熬过的低谷，都化作破壁时最耀眼的荣光。
top.en: I know, I know, sit down. That was the Worlds stage, a night that allowed the entire LPL to finally breathe a sigh of relief. The arena was breathless, red and blue clashing, noise and silence alternating. Every engage, every bit of spacing, was a burning footnote on the road to breaking our mental block. Thirteen straight losses at Worlds, like thirteen old scars, weighed on the LPL's long memory of T1; countless times we had dreams at the start only to regret the end. Fate kept pushing the 'T1 fear' in front of the LPL. BLG hasn't been without doubt. Mistakes, being reverse-swept, choking in key games—they've heard it all. But this time, shedding the impatience and hesitation, they were steady and determined. No flashy luck, just hard-earned coordination and the decisiveness of a team with their backs against the wall. Every hold was a display of responsibility under pressure; every engage was a fight against past regrets. The match was a back-and-forth thriller, the score climbing, the momentum shifting, everyone waiting for the end. When the final teamfight on T1's base settled and the sound of the nexus exploding echoed through the arena, all the anxiety found its home. Thirteen losses, ended. The wall of our mental block, shattered. This wasn't just a win. It was BLG turning the final page on the LPL's history against T1 at Worlds; years of suppression released, a long-awaited echo. The cheers exploded, the spotlights fell, and the old curse finally became a footnote to our breakthrough. Every game is a choice, every year we break walls. This isn't just BLG's triumph; it's the night the LPL erased 'T1 fear' from the history books, turning every thorn we stepped on and every low point we endured into the most dazzling glory.

top.zh:
十四年的宿命高墙，今天被BLG一拳砸穿。

从S3的初见惊惶，到此后无数次饮恨赛场，T1这座横亘在LPL心头的大山，压了整整一代人的电竞青春。我们见过赛点被翻的遗憾，见过被横扫的落寞，见过一次又一次倒在同一条河流里的不甘，久到几乎所有人都默认了那道名为“不可战胜”的魔咒。

可BLG偏不认命。
从瑞士轮跌跌撞撞闯出生路，八强零封DK，四强3:1亲手斩落T1，把S14决赛的遗憾亲手了结，把十四年的不败神话彻底打碎。水晶爆炸的那一刻，所有深夜的守候、落空的期待、憋了十几年的那口气，全都化作滚烫的呐喊。

这不是冷门，是天道酬勤；这不是侥幸，是百炼成钢。
热血难凉，少年意气最动人心。恭喜BLG，踏碎韩营，挺进决赛；愿你们乘胜而上，把冠军奖杯，带回LPL！

top.en:
The fourteen-year wall of fate was smashed through by BLG today with one punch. From the panic of our first meeting in S3 to the countless times we drank the bitterness of defeat, T1 has been the mountain looming over the LPL, weighing down the esports youth of an entire generation. We've seen the regret of being reverse-swept at match point, the loneliness of being swept, the frustration of falling into the same river over and over, for so long that everyone defaulted to the curse called 'invincibility'. But BLG refused to accept that fate.
From stumbling out of the [~0:Swiss stage], sweeping DK in the quarterfinals, and personally cutting down T1 3:1 in the semifinals, they settled the regrets of S14 and shattered the fourteen-year myth of invincibility. The moment the nexus exploded, all the late-night vigils, the dashed expectations, and the breath we'd been holding for over a decade turned into a burning roar. This isn't an upset; it's heaven rewarding diligence. This isn't luck; it's steel forged in fire.
Passion is hard to cool, and the spirit of youth is the most moving thing. Congratulations to BLG, for crushing the Korean camp and advancing to the finals; may you ride the momentum and bring the championship trophy back to the LPL!

notes.context: The group stage format at Worlds where teams play opponents with similar records.

top.en: In the 41 seconds before the ultimate dominance was unleashed, Bin's chant echoed in the dragon pit: 'Cull the Meek', 'Ruthless Predator', 'Slice and Dice', 'Dominus'. At this moment, Renekton's twin blades crossed before Faker's eyes; Faker understood he had no chance to stop the ultimate dominance from being unleashed. The fury of Dominus lit up the dragon pit like a nuclear explosion, and Akali's Shuriken Flip was reduced to ashes in the slashes of Cull the Meek. Renekton appeared like a force of nature at the landing point of Slice and Dice, and Faker's health bar, representing his life, vanished in chunks. In the pit, 'I am the master of my own style!' Faker, in the Shroud, leaned weakly against the edge of the pit to support himself; his health bar was almost entirely devoured by this strike. In the short 41 seconds before his ultimate was off cooldown, Bin countered every move, completing several textbook-level improvisational plays. Xun's voice was filled with irrepressible ecstasy, and Knight stared into the distance, unable to believe what was happening—which is to say, yes, BLG won.

top.zh:
LPL世谱
LPL十三岁，BLG伐T1，破十有三载BO5不胜之谶，是为谱系之始。

昔LCK有强邦，号T1，魔王主之，纵横十余年，凡LPL诸侯与之会猎于全球之巅BO5，未尝一胜。S14之役，BLG苦战五局，惜败而返，中原志士扼腕。

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。
top.en:
LPL Annals of Lineage
In the thirteenth year of the LPL, BLG smote T1, breaking the omen of thirteen years without a BO5 victory, thus marking the origin of the lineage. In former days, LCK had a mighty state named T1, ruled by the Demon King, dominating for over a decade. Whenever the lords of the LPL met them in battle at the summit of the world in a BO5, they never tasted victory. In the campaign of Season 14, BLG fought through five grueling games, returning with bitter defeat as chivalrous men of the Central Plains clenched their fists in regret. Come Season 16, BLG rose anew, campaigning across the seas. Smashing DK in the quarterfinals, facing T1 in the semifinals. Bin held the top lane, Knight held the center, Xun controlled the jungle, and Viper and ON secured the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally subdued T1. A century-old inner demon shattered in a single morning, and the LPL recorded its very first victory against T1 in an international BO5. Tracing their history:
In Season 8, IG arose from the grassroots, slaying KT, crushing G2, and taking down FNC to claim the first sacred cup, opening the prosperity of the Central Plains.
In Season 9, FPX followed, phoenix-like rising from the flames to seize the crown once more.
In Season 11, EDG journeyed afar to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne and establishing their foundation with three titles. Amidst this, Royal Club twice entered the finals, returning to drink the cup of regret; OMG fought South Korea in lone battle, earning fame in Busan; RNG repeatedly conquered the Mid-Season Invitational, spreading their might in mid-season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just a step short of ultimate completion. Teams like TES, LNG, and WE each achieved great feats, yet also suffered many shattered spears. Ever since T1 was broken in Season 16, the grand trend of the LPL realm transformed utterly. The formidable enemy that once loomed like a border threat was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generation after generation of heroes in the region carried the torch, and the resolve of foreign expeditions was renewed from this day forth. In praise:
Toiling through night and day in battle, long trapped at the majestic pass.
Stirring in Season 16, smashing the stubborn T.
Three world titles ahead, let those who come after continue to climb.
Let this lineage be remembered forever, as valiant warriors ascend the altar.

I've been watching since 2022 and I felt nothing but despair. To those players and fans who kept persisting, thank you, you are all heroes.

Later, I wanted to watch, so I clicked on the stream and saw Knight getting picked off, I was scared to death. Thank you, thank you to the five of you, thank you ON. I'm really grateful. My youth, my youth... I looked back, my whole post has no logic, I really can't speak. I imagined this moment, but I was afraid, I was afraid it was just champagne, I was afraid of so much. Did we win? We really won! Thank you Bin, thank you, thank you. Thank you Knight, thank you Wenjun, thank you Daohyeon, thank you Xun, thank you Danny, thank you Flandre. Thank you all, I made it, I waited until the first day and I really cried. I really never thought we would win one day.

全都是借口，说什么不能留在3-1池要去逮捕hle，固执己见地为了复仇逮捕dk，自以为是地满足一己之私，放任伙伴无意义的死去。是我想亲手了结hle和dk的私心，造成了现在的状况。我的错，就由我来终结。
所以，领域展开！
屏幕之上硝烟纵横，碎裂的水晶与熄灭的信号交错成这片赛场的残垣，倒下的同袍身影浮在视野边缘。落于地面的IG残骸更让四强赛内杀机重重，他脸上的神情却是无比坚定，“我要在剩下一个bo5内，把一切全部结束。”
top.en:
Everything is an excuse. Saying you couldn't stay in the 3-1 pool to arrest HLE, stubbornly insisting on arresting DK for revenge, satisfying your own selfish desires, letting your teammates die in vain. It was my own selfishness to personally finish off HLE and DK that caused the current situation. My mistake, I will end it myself.
So, Domain Expansion!
Above the screen, smoke and fire crisscross, shattered crystals and extinguished signals interweave into the ruins of this arena, the figures of fallen comrades floating at the edge of my vision. The IG wreckage on the ground makes the semifinals even more murderous, yet the expression on his face is incredibly firm: 'I will end everything within the remaining Bo5.'

top.en: Thirteen years to finally win a Worlds best-of-five against T1. Even if all the other LPL teams fall, Knight is still standing here, BLG is still standing here, and the last dawn of the LPL shines in Texas. They slaughtered HLE, they crushed DK, they took down T1! This Worlds isn't LCK versus LPL, it's BLG versus the entire LCK! The exact words of the English caster from S13 when T1 ran a gauntlet through four teams—I honestly never expected BLG to replicate that exact script one day, it almost makes me want to cry. Even the Swiss stage record is identical: 2-0 against HLE in Swiss, 3-0 against DK in the quarterfinals, 3-1 against T1 in the semifinals.

top.zh:
十四年的宿命高墙，今天被BLG一拳砸穿。

从S3的初见惊惶，到此后无数次饮恨赛场，T1这座横亘在LPL心头的大山，压了整整一代人的电竞青春。我们见过赛点被翻的遗憾，见过被横扫的落寞，见过一次又一次倒在同一条河流里的不甘，久到几乎所有人都默认了那道名为“不可战胜”的魔咒。

可BLG偏不认命。
从瑞士轮跌跌撞撞闯出生路，八强零封DK，四强3:1亲手斩落T1，把S14决赛的遗憾亲手了结，把十四年的不败神话彻底打碎。水晶爆炸的那一刻，所有深夜的守候、落空的期待、憋了十几年的那口气，全都化作滚烫的呐喊。

这不是冷门，是天道酬勤；这不是侥幸，是百炼成钢。
热血难凉，少年意气最动人心。恭喜BLG，踏碎韩营，挺进决赛；愿你们乘胜而上，把冠军奖杯，带回LPL！
top.en:
The fourteen-year wall of fate was smashed through by BLG with one punch today. From the initial panic of S3 to the countless regrets on the field since then, T1, the mountain looming over the LPL's heart, has weighed down an entire generation's esports youth. We've seen the regret of being reverse-swept at match point, the loneliness of being swept, the unwillingness of falling into the same river time and time again, for so long that almost everyone defaulted to that curse called 'invincibility'. But BLG refused to accept their fate.
Stumbling out of the [~0:Swiss stage], sweeping DK in the quarterfinals, personally cutting down T1 3:1 in the semifinals, personally ending the regrets of the S14 finals, and completely shattering the fourteen-year undefeated myth. The moment the crystal exploded, all the late-night waiting, the empty expectations, and the breath held for over a decade turned into a scorching roar. This isn't an upset, it's hard work paying off; this isn't luck, it's steel forged in fire.
Passion is hard to cool, and the spirit of youth is the most moving. Congratulations to BLG, for trampling the Korean camp and advancing to the finals; may you ride the momentum and bring the championship trophy back to the LPL!

notes.context: The Swiss stage format used in recent Worlds tournaments.

top.zh:
LPL世谱
LPL十三岁，BLG伐T1，破十有三载BO5不胜之谶，是为谱系之始。

昔LCK有强邦，号T1，魔王主之，纵横十余年，凡LPL诸侯与之会猎于全球之巅BO5，未尝一胜。S14之役，BLG苦战五局，惜败而返，中原志士扼腕。

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。

top.en:
LPL Annals of Lineage
In the thirteenth year of the LPL, BLG smote T1, breaking the omen of thirteen years without a BO5 victory, thus marking the origin of the lineage. In former days, LCK had a mighty state named T1, ruled by the Demon King, dominating for over a decade. Whenever the lords of the LPL met them in battle at the summit of the world in a BO5, they never tasted victory. In the campaign of Season 14, BLG fought through five grueling games, returning with bitter defeat as chivalrous men of the Central Plains clenched their fists in regret. Come Season 16, BLG rose anew, campaigning across the seas. Smashing DK in the quarterfinals, facing T1 in the semifinals. Bin held the top lane, Knight held the center, Xun controlled the jungle, and Viper and ON secured the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally subdued T1. A century-old inner demon shattered in a single morning, and the LPL recorded its very first victory against T1 in an international BO5. Tracing their history:
In Season 8, IG arose from the grassroots, slaying KT, crushing G2, and taking down FNC to claim the first sacred cup, opening the prosperity of the Central Plains.
In Season 9, FPX followed, phoenix-like rising from the flames to seize the crown once more.
In Season 11, EDG journeyed afar to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne and establishing their foundation with three titles. Amidst this, Royal Club twice entered the finals, returning to drink the cup of regret; OMG fought South Korea in lone battle, earning fame in Busan; RNG repeatedly conquered the Mid-Season Invitational, spreading their might in mid-season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just a step short of ultimate completion. Teams like TES, LNG, and WE each achieved great feats, yet also suffered many shattered spears. Ever since T1 was broken in Season 16, the grand trend of the LPL realm transformed utterly. The formidable enemy that once loomed like a border threat was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generation after generation of heroes in the region carried the torch, and the resolve of foreign expeditions was renewed from this day forth. In praise:
Toiling through night and day in battle, long trapped at the majestic pass.
Stirring in Season 16, smashing the stubborn T.
Three world titles ahead, let those who come after continue to climb.
Let this lineage be remembered forever, as valiant warriors ascend the altar.

top.zh: 恭喜BLG创造历史，挺进决赛。我是S3开始玩的老玩家了，从S5开始看faker比赛，说实话，无论什么时候，我从来没否认过我是faker的粉丝。我其实有预感今天T1会输，但我的私心是打满第五把再输，可是T1里的那几条区都在犯罪，实在让人难绷。至于决赛，我认为会是BLG夺冠，在一个多星期前，我梦见了BLG横扫T1挺进决赛拿下冠军。说实话，那天我醒来，回想起这个梦有些彷徨，有些难受。S12决赛前一个星期，我梦到了DRX夺冠。S13打京东前我梦到了T1横扫对手夺冠，S14淘汰赛开始前，我梦到决赛上，T1 1-2落后，faker站出来力挽狂澜拿下fmvp，决赛的对手有些朦胧我没看见。S15KT3-0出线的时候，我梦见T1决战KT拿下3连冠。连续四次的应验让我看到S16梦境的时候有些彷徨，不过好像也没什么彷徨的，我早知道faker应该要到此为止了，四强其实也达到了我一开始的预期。至于决赛，BLG加油吧，希望这次我的梦境依然能够实现。
top.en: Congratulations to BLG on making history and advancing to the finals. I'm an old player who started playing in Season 3 and watching Faker's games since Season 5. To be honest, no matter what, I've never denied that I'm a Faker fan. I actually had a hunch today that T1 would lose, but my selfish wish was for it to go to a full five games before losing, yet those few lanes on T1 were straight-up committing crimes, which was really hard to watch. As for the finals, I think BLG will take the championship. Over a week ago, I dreamed that BLG swept T1 to advance to the finals and took the title. To be honest, when I woke up that day, recalling that dream felt a bit uncertain and painful. The week before the Season 12 finals, I dreamed DRX won the championship. Before the match against JDG in Season 13, I dreamed T1 swept their opponent to win it all. Before the Season 14 knockout stage started, I dreamed that in the finals, T1 was down 1-2, and Faker stepped up to turn the tide and win FMVP, though the opponent in the finals was a bit blurry and I couldn't see them. When KT qualified 3-0 in Season 15, I dreamed T1 fought KT in the decider and won their 3rd consecutive title. These four consecutive accurate premonitions made me feel a bit uneasy seeing the Season 16 dream, but I guess there's nothing to feel uneasy about anymore; I've long known Faker's run should end here, and the semifinals actually met my initial expectations. As for the finals, let's go BLG, hopefully my dream can come true once again.

top.en: Congratulations to BLG on making history and advancing to the finals. I'm an old player who started playing in Season 3 and watching Faker's games since Season 5. To be honest, no matter what, I've never denied that I'm a Faker fan. I actually had a hunch today that T1 would lose, but my selfish wish was for it to go to a full five games before losing, yet those few lanes on T1 were straight-up committing crimes, which was really hard to watch. As for the finals, I think BLG will take the championship. Over a week ago, I dreamed that BLG swept T1 to advance to the finals and took the title. To be honest, when I woke up that day, recalling that dream felt a bit uncertain and painful. The week before the Season 12 finals, I dreamed DRX won the championship. Before the match against JDG in Season 13, I dreamed T1 swept their opponent to win it all. Before the Season 14 knockout stage started, I dreamed that in the finals, T1 was down 1-2, and Faker stepped up to turn the tide and win FMVP, though the opponent in the finals was a bit blurry and I couldn't see them. When KT qualified 3-0 in Season 15, I dreamed T1 fought KT in the decider and won their 3rd consecutive title. These four consecutive accurate premonitions made me feel a bit uneasy seeing the Season 16 dream, but I guess there's nothing to feel uneasy about anymore; I've long known Faker's run should end here, and the semifinals actually met my initial expectations. As for the finals, let's go BLG, hopefully my dream can come true once again.

top.zh:
LPL世谱
LPL十三岁，BLG伐T1，破十有三载BO5不胜之谶，是为谱系之始。

昔LCK有强邦，号T1，魔王主之，纵横十余年，凡LPL诸侯与之会猎于全球之巅BO5，未尝一胜。S14之役，BLG苦战五局，惜败而返，中原志士扼腕。

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。
top.en:
LPL Annals of Lineage
In the thirteenth year of the LPL, BLG smote T1, breaking the omen of thirteen years without a BO5 victory, thus marking the origin of the lineage. In former days, LCK had a mighty state named T1, ruled by the Demon King, dominating for over a decade. Whenever the lords of the LPL met them in battle at the summit of the world in a BO5, they never tasted victory. In the campaign of Season 14, BLG fought through five grueling games, returning with bitter defeat as chivalrous men of the Central Plains clenched their fists in regret. Come Season 16, BLG rose anew, campaigning across the seas. Smashing DK in the quarterfinals, facing T1 in the semifinals. Bin held the top lane, Knight held the center, Xun controlled the jungle, and Viper and ON secured the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally subdued T1. A century-old inner demon shattered in a single morning, and the LPL recorded its very first victory against T1 in an international BO5. Tracing their history:
In Season 8, IG arose from the grassroots, slaying KT, crushing G2, and taking down FNC to claim the first sacred cup, opening the prosperity of the Central Plains.
In Season 9, FPX followed, phoenix-like rising from the flames to seize the crown once more.
In Season 11, EDG journeyed afar to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne and establishing their foundation with three titles. Amidst this, Royal Club twice entered the finals, returning to drink the cup of regret; OMG fought South Korea in lone battle, earning fame in Busan; RNG repeatedly conquered the Mid-Season Invitational, spreading their might in mid-season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just a step short of ultimate completion. Teams like TES, LNG, and WE each achieved great feats, yet also suffered many shattered spears. Ever since T1 was broken in Season 16, the grand trend of the LPL realm transformed utterly. The formidable enemy that once loomed like a border threat was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generation after generation of heroes in the region carried the torch, and the resolve of foreign expeditions was renewed from this day forth. In praise:
Toiling through night and day in battle, long trapped at the majestic pass.
Stirring in Season 16, smashing the stubborn T.
Three world titles ahead, let those who come after continue to climb.
Let this lineage be remembered forever, as valiant warriors ascend the altar.

top.zh: 感慨的是虽然输了，但是真的尽力了，一整年的起起伏伏。在昨夜梦中就多次梦到结局。回想起自己看英雄联盟的比赛真的好早，s5，11年前，当时的瑞兹直到现在都没有忘记，三年三冠也伴随着我大学三年，虽然不知道怎么说，但是我可能粉的就只是faker。想到s7被三星零封的时候，有总想哭的冲动，s8没有进世界赛但是联赛上依旧有亮眼表现，s9当时以为是银河战舰但是msi和世界赛都输给了g2。s10开始宫斗，s11慢慢组建起了王朝的雏形，s12高考那年，决赛结束回到学校感觉很不真实，唯一不敢回看的比赛，后面三年世界赛是梦幻的三年，s14通宵看你比赛，塞拉斯和加里奥看的我真的又一次想哭的冲动。直到今年，看到你续约那么久，总是想着打的越久可能给人的感觉就是菜，状态下滑，想着你如果赶紧退役功成身退多好，想着你被骂的时候其实挺难过的。我也不懂为什么极端粉丝这么喜欢拉踩别人。但是转念一想，你确实热爱这个游戏，也在维持着这个游戏的热度，这次输了反而没有以前那么难过，更多的是一种释然，只是希望你能一直享受这个比赛，享受这个游戏。相信后面的比赛，无论输赢我都会继续看，直到你退役为止。

thread.zh: 其实他释然了，我们也何尝不是释怀了呢，毕竟记录终归是会打破的，但更让我觉得释怀的是他还是那么一往无前，完美地释放了自己，而不是畏畏缩缩，苟到死，都说年纪大了，做什么都心酸，但在他的表现上我看到了竞技体育的光辉
thread.en: Actually, he has made peace with it, and so have we in a way. After all, records are meant to be broken. But what brings me even more peace is seeing that he's still as fearless as ever, putting everything out there perfectly instead of playing like a coward just to survive. They say as you get older everything feels heartbreaking, but in his performance, I saw the true brilliance of competitive sports.

top.en: What touches me is that although you lost, you truly tried your absolute best through a whole year of ups and downs. In my dreams last night I kept seeing the ending. Thinking back, I started watching League esports so long ago, S5, 11 years ago; I still haven't forgotten that Ryze back then, and your three consecutive Worlds titles accompanied my three years in college. Though I don't know how to put it, maybe I'm just a fan of Faker himself. Remembering when you got 3-0ed by [~0:GEN] in S7, I had an urge to cry; in S8 you missed Worlds but still had eye-catching performances in the league; in S9 I thought we were a galactic battleship, but we lost to G2 in both MSI and Worlds. S10 started internal palace struggles, S11 slowly built the embryonic form of a dynasty, and in S12, the year of my college entrance exams, walking back to school after the finals felt so surreal—the only match I never dared to rewatch. The past three [~1:Worlds] have been like a dream, and in S14 staying up all night watching your matches, Sylas and Galio made me feel that urge to cry once again. Until this year, seeing you renew your contract for so long, I always thought that the longer you play, the more people might think you're washed up and your form is dropping, and I secretly wished you would just retire while on top so you wouldn't get flamed, which actually felt quite sad when it happened. I don't get why toxic fans love pitting players against each other. But on second thought, you truly love this game and keep it relevant. Losing this time didn't feel as painful as before; there's more of a sense of release. I just hope you can keep enjoying this match and enjoying this game. I believe that for the matches to come, win or lose, I'll keep watching until you retire.

notes.context: Refers to the LCK team Gen.G, historically known as Samsung Galaxy.

Lee Sang-hyeok looked back with a smile at the T1 team logo and fell into deep thought: 'People always say I'm the LPL's number one nemesis, but I know that outside the arena I might actually be the LPL's best friend. I've witnessed countless so-called geniuses break their swords at my feet, and personally crushed every god except myself, forcing them down. I've witnessed the prime years of so many gaming youths. Walking off the stage, I glanced down at my deformed hands from endless practice. I drifted into a daze for a split second—today, the LPL beat me. Strangely enough, on this day I didn't feel depressed, but rather experienced a shred of relief. The younger generation on BLG has grown up and finally learned to respect the old man of the arena. I have no reason to [~0:agree].' Lee Sang-hyeok nodded to the empty air and walked off the stage with confidence. Halfway there, as if remembering something, he looked back toward the very center of the front stage. Turns out, the ID Faker had already been walking for so long.
—— Memoirs of President Lee Sang-hyeok

过去13年，13次交锋，从无胜绩。

加油吧，BLG！取经之路，就在脚下！去捧起属于你们的冠军奖杯吧！

top.en:
Over the past 13 years, 13 matchups, zero wins.
Today, let's congratulate BLG for holding their ground, overcoming their inner demons, and defeating T1 3:1 to end their long reign.
They did it! Faker still played at an exceptionally high competitive level. In the final game, his desperate Akali could still charge alone into the enemy lines amidst a massive deficit, dancing in and out of danger and nearly turning the game around, breaking everyone out in a cold sweat. If Faker had chosen to retire in glory after his triple championship, this victory would forever exist only in imagination, and the lingering regrets of generations of esports fans would become permanent. But he chose to bravely stand on stage, giving the newcomers a chance to defeat him head-on.
Faker always says records are meant to be broken, and no one stays undefeated forever. His past career is just like Akali's ultimate, 'Perfect Execution'. Dazzling the world upon his first appearance, lurking in the shadows, only to return to the stage and forge greatness once more. Perhaps the lesson of 'perfect execution' is how to still stay true to your original self after shedding all the halos! The moment the game ended, gazing at Faker's relieved smile, I suddenly recalled the Buddhist verse chanted by Lu Zhishen before his passing: 'When the tidal bore arrives on the Qiantang River, today I finally know who I am.'
Indeed, results cannot define existence, experiences can. That holds true for both Faker and BLG as they march toward the championship. Anyone's 13 years are still 13 years. Keep going, BLG! The journey to the west is right beneath your feet! Go lift your championship trophy!

top.zh: 纵观lol电竞史也是极富宿命感的一瞥，faker的统治记录终结，反而更成就了他在凡人之躯里展示出的不可思议的坚韧、自律和果决，当之无愧的GOAT。

top.zh: 十几年的记录终究还是没有维持住，就好像你赛前所说的，记录只是会有更多的人去关注，去打破，但今年的T1像是少了太多理由，三连冠，没有太多人希望你们继续王朝，凹凸不平的队伍配置，圆满的粉丝也并不难受，微微释怀，就像我一样，从支持，到坚定，空白的期待里缓慢溢出暖黄色的温柔与坚守，Faker真的很厉害，不是因为他多厉害，而是这一次，T1少了许多理由，但是Faker没有,他只是没有变，原来不变，真的就是如此美妙的和弦，我开始期待了，开始期待31岁的，哦不，06年年轻小将的风采了。我们LPL需要这个冠军。这样的blg赢下来光芒万丈。
top.en: The dozen-year record couldn't be maintained after all. Just like you said before the match, records are just there for more people to watch and break, but T1 this year felt lacking in so many reasons. A three-peat, not many people wanted you to continue the dynasty. With a jagged roster configuration, fans finding closure don't feel too heartbroken either—just a slight sense of relief, much like myself. From support to unwavering belief, a warm yellow gentleness and steadfastness slowly overflowed from the empty expectations. Faker is truly amazing, not because of how overpowered he is, but because this time, T1 had many reasons to fall, yet Faker didn't. He just stayed unchanged. Turns out staying unchanged really is such a wondrous chord. I've started looking forward to it, looking forward to the flair of a young prodigy at 31, or rather, back in '06. Our LPL needs this championship. A BLG that wins like this shines with dazzling brilliance.

top.zh:
LPL世谱
LPL十三岁，BLG伐T1，破十有三载BO5不胜之谶，是为谱系之始。

昔LCK有强邦，号T1，魔王主之，纵横十余年，凡LPL诸侯与之会猎于全球之巅BO5，未尝一胜。S14之役，BLG苦战五局，惜败而返，中原志士扼腕。

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。
top.en:
Chronicles of the LPL
In the 13th year of the LPL, BLG [~0:subdued] T1, shattering the prophecy of going 13 years without a [~1:bo5] win against them; thus began this lineage. In ancient times, the LCK boasted a mighty state named T1, ruled by the Demon King. They reigned supreme for over a decade, and whenever the feudal lords of the LPL met them in battle at the [~2:Worlds] summit in a bo5, they never tasted victory. In the campaign of [~3:S14], BLG fought through a grueling five games, returning in bitter defeat while the heroes of the Central Plains grieved. Come [~4:S16], BLG rose once more, marching on foreign lands. In the quarterfinals they crushed DK, and in the semifinals they confronted T1. Bin held the top, Knight held the mid, Xun mastered the jungle, and Viper and ON fortified the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally conquered T1. A century-old mental demon was shattered in a single morning, marking the first time the LPL defeated T1 in a world-stage bo5. Tracing their history:
In [~5:S8], iG arose from the grassroots, slaying KT, breaking G2, taking down FNC, and claiming the first sacred cup to usher in the glory of the Central Plains.
In [~6:S9], FPX followed, rising like a phoenix from the ashes to seize the crown once more.
In [~7:S11], EDG journeyed afar to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne and cement their three titles. Along the way, RNG entered the finals twice, returning with swallowed hatred; the lone warriors of [~8:OMG] fought against Korea, their names shaking Busan; RNG marched to [~9:MSI] multiple times, projecting their might in the Mid-Season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just short of ultimate greatness. TES, LNG, and WE each achieved glories, yet many were the shattered spears. Ever since T1 was broken in S16, the geopolitical landscape of the LPL underwent a seismic shift. The erstwhile towering behemoth was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generations of regional powerhouses carried the torch, and the resolve in international warfare was forever renewed. An ode in praise:
Toiling day and night in battle, long trapped before the mighty pass.
Stirring in S16, shattering the stubborn T.
Three world titles lie ahead, let those who follow keep climbing.
Let these chronicles be forever remembered, as brave men ascend the altar.

notes.context: Classical phrasing used here to mean waging a military campaign to defeat an enemy.

top.en: I've been crying this whole time, I can finally type now. I will always believe in you, no matter how the 23 [~0:MSI] ended in a fizzle, or how [~1:Bin] [~2:choked] at Worlds, or how [~3:Xun] went off, or that night in London... Whether it was missing the playoffs in the first split of 25, or struggling all through the second split and scraping into MSI only to get [~4:cleansed through the toilet], or being mocked as the first-seed [~5:16th place] at [~6:Worlds]... I don't know how much pressure you've been under. As a viewer, as your fan, I honestly felt like I was breaking down. Throughout this 26 year, you still didn't give up. The first split had some rough synergy, but you entered the [~7:First Stand] and swept through like a force of nature to take the championship. Back then I really felt like I saw the dawn, I saw hope. But MSI and the third split had so many, many internal issues—talk of top-jungle discord, talk of palace intrigue. Yet I always believed in you, I always supported you. Even during the very last game against HLE this year, staying up all night to watch your matches, I just forever believed in you. You've always shown your hyper-resilience both on and off the stage. In that first game against HLE, I genuinely thought we were doomed, but you still pulled off a miraculous comeback through sheer grit. And against DK it was a clean 3:0 sweep. To be honest, today during game 3 my heart was in my throat, I thought we were going to choke again. But facts proved that the team I support is right, my choice was correct. No matter what, even if you choke another 10,000 times, get mocked by everyone, and countless rumors of internal discord come out, I will still choose to support you. They used to say BLG had no international trophies, but we did it at [~8:First Stand]. Last year at First Stand, HLE [~9:spun LPL like a top] and T1 shut out BLG, but today we got our revenge. I just hope that final regret from 24 can be made right in the next match. Let's go, always believe in you, always support BLG!

thread.zh: 那我这种从s3第一次看Faker踩着皇族夺冠一直看到现在的老人家怎么办？我们经历过s3的茫然，s4的无奈，也体会过s5的绝望。还好我们没被打趴下，触底反弹。s8s9是lck的低谷，我们拿了冠军，可惜我们决赛打的不是lck，s11我们接连赢了三星和dk，只差一个t1就可以圆梦了。于是我们一直在等，从s13被t1一穿三，到s14被那个塞拉斯翻盘，还有那个s15决胜局选出了人生第一把蒙多。一度怀疑在Faker的职业生涯里，在LOL这个游戏被我们彻底放下之前，LPL还有没有机会去亲手击败英雄联盟最高的山最长的河，还好，在今天，我们终于做到了！
thread.en: So what about an old-timer like me who has been watching since S3 when Faker stepped on RNG to win the title? We've experienced the confusion of S3, the helplessness of S4, and the despair of S5. Luckily, we weren't beaten down; we bounced back from the bottom. S8 and S9 were the LCK's low points, and we won the titles, but unfortunately, we didn't play the LCK in the finals. In S11, we beat GEN and DK, and we were only one T1 away from fulfilling our dream. So we kept waiting, from being swept by T1 in S13, to being reverse-swept by that Sylas in S14, and that S15 deciding game where he picked Dr. Mundo for the first time in his life. I once doubted if, during Faker's career and before the game of LoL was completely abandoned by us, the LPL would ever have the chance to personally defeat the highest mountain and the longest river in League of Legends. Luckily, today, we finally did it!

top.en: From the first time I watched matches when RNG lost to SKT in S7, time has flown to S16, and I've always wanted to see an LPL team defeat T1 head-on. Thank you for making up for my past regrets [大哭]

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。

top.en:
Chronicles of the LPL
In the 13th year of the LPL, BLG [~0:subdued] T1, shattering the prophecy of going 13 years without a [~1:bo5] win against them; thus began this lineage. In ancient times, the LCK boasted a mighty state named T1, ruled by the Demon King. They reigned supreme for over a decade, and whenever the feudal lords of the LPL met them in battle at the [~2:Worlds] summit in a bo5, they never tasted victory. In the campaign of [~3:S14], BLG fought through a grueling five games, returning in bitter defeat while the heroes of the Central Plains grieved. Come [~4:S16], BLG rose once more, marching on foreign lands. In the quarterfinals they crushed DK, and in the semifinals they confronted T1. Bin held the top, Knight held the mid, Xun mastered the jungle, and Viper and ON fortified the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally conquered T1. A century-old mental demon was shattered in a single morning, marking the first time the LPL defeated T1 in a world-stage bo5. Tracing their history:
In [~5:S8], iG arose from the grassroots, slaying KT, breaking G2, taking down FNC, and claiming the first sacred cup to usher in the glory of the Central Plains.
In [~6:S9], FPX followed, rising like a phoenix from the ashes to seize the crown once more.
In [~7:S11], EDG journeyed afar to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne and cement their three titles. Along the way, RNG entered the finals twice, returning with swallowed hatred; the lone warriors of [~8:OMG] fought against Korea, their names shaking Busan; RNG marched to [~9:MSI] multiple times, projecting their might in the Mid-Season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just short of ultimate greatness. TES, LNG, and WE each achieved glories, yet many were the shattered spears. Ever since T1 was broken in S16, the geopolitical landscape of the LPL underwent a seismic shift. The erstwhile towering behemoth was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generations of regional powerhouses carried the torch, and the resolve in international warfare was forever renewed. An ode in praise:
Toiling day and night in battle, long trapped before the mighty pass.
Stirring in S16, shattering the stubborn T.
Three world titles lie ahead, let those who follow keep climbing.
Let these chronicles be forever remembered, as brave men ascend the altar.

top.en: Thank you BLG and T1 for giving us such a brilliant match. When BLG got eliminated in 24 I was numb, but today I finally understood that when human emotions are repressed to the absolute limit, the release makes you cry tears of joy. I cried for half an hour; in that half an hour, so many grievances, regrets, and humiliations from all these years washed away like flowing water. Thank you for holding the line all these years, we are just one final battle away from the dawn! Faker's legend has drawn to a close; facing LCK's greatest powerhouse and Chovy who has broken his mental demons, the outcome remains unknown. Only forward! Forward! Forward!

top.zh:
LPL世谱
LPL十三岁，BLG伐T1，破十有三载BO5不胜之谶，是为谱系之始。

昔LCK有强邦，号T1，魔王主之，纵横十余年，凡LPL诸侯与之会猎于全球之巅BO5，未尝一胜。S14之役，BLG苦战五局，惜败而返，中原志士扼腕。

及至S16，BLG再起，征于海外。八进四摧DK，半决赛临T1。Bin镇上，Knight当中，Xun掌野，Viper、ON固下路。四局鏖战，三捷一负，遂克T1。百年心魔一朝碎，LPL始有胜T1于世界BO5之记录。

溯其前史：
S8，iG起于草莽，斩KT，破G2，收FNC，首取神杯，开中原之盛。
S9，FPX继之，浴火涅槃，再夺魁首。
S11，EDG远征冰岛，克DK，登极，三冠立本。

其间有皇族两入决赛，饮恨而归；OMG孤军伐韩，名震釜山；RNG数征MSI，扬威季中；WBG、BLG先后临决赛，差一步而未竟大功。TES、LNG、WE诸部，各有雄绩，亦多折戟。

自S16破T1之后，LPL天下大势一变。昔日压境之强敌，不复为不可逾越之山。此后赛区群雄，代代相承，外战之志，自此而新。

赞曰：
夙夜鏖兵，久困雄关。
S16振，摧破T顽。
三冠在前，来者继攀。
此谱永记，壮士登坛。

top.en:
The LPL Chronicles
In the thirteenth year of the [~0:LPL], BLG marched against T1, breaking the thirteen-year curse of never winning a [~1:BO5] against them, thus beginning a new lineage. In former times there was a mighty state in [~2:LCK] named T1, ruled by the Demon King, dominating for over a decade. Whenever the lords of the [~0:LPL] met them in battle at the summit of the world in a [~1:BO5], they never tasted victory. In the campaign of [~3:S14], BLG fought for five grueling games, returning in narrow defeat as the heroes of the realm clenched their fists in grief. By the time of [~4:S16], BLG rose once more, campaigning overseas. In the quarterfinals they crushed DK, and in the semifinals faced T1. Bin held the top lane, Knight held the mid lane, Xun commanded the jungle, and Viper and ON locked down the bot lane. After four fierce battles, taking three and losing one, they finally conquered T1. A century-old inner demon shattered in an instant, marking the LPL's very first [~1:BO5] victory over T1 at an international tournament. Tracing the history before this:
In [~5:S8], iG rose from the grassroots, slaying KT, breaking G2, dispatching FNC, claiming the sacred cup for the first time, and inaugurating the glory of the realm.
In [~6:S9], FPX followed in their footsteps, rising from the ashes like a phoenix to seize the crown once more.
In [~7:S11], EDG undertook a far expedition to Iceland, defeating DK to ascend the throne, establishing the foundation of their three titles. Amidst this, Royal Club twice entered the finals, swallowing the bitter pill of defeat; OMG marched alone against Korea, their fame shaking Busan; RNG repeatedly campaigned at MSI, displaying their might in the mid-season; WBG and BLG successively reached the finals, falling just short of ultimate success. TES, LNG, and WE each achieved glorious feats, yet many times tasted defeat. Ever since T1 was broken in [~4:S16], the grand balance of power in the [~0:LPL] shifted entirely. The once-towering formidable enemy was no longer an insurmountable mountain. From then on, generation after generation of heroes within the region inherited the legacy, and their resolve in foreign wars was ever renewed. In praise:
Battling day and night, long trapped before the mighty gate.
In [~4:S16] they shook the realm, crushing stubborn T1.
Three titles stand before us, let those who follow continue the climb.
Remember these chronicles forever, as brave warriors ascend the altar.

top.zh: 1. 谁能想到曾经被T1的BO5魔咒压得喘不过气的LPL，今天BLG亲手把这层枷锁撕碎了。多少年了，每次碰到T1的BO5总带着遗憾离场，无数次差一点，无数次扼腕叹息。但今天不一样，Bin扛住压力，全队稳扎稳打，没有被T1的运营节奏牵着鼻子走，曾经跨不过去的大山，这次直接踏在脚下。李哥依旧在拼命找机会，传奇值得尊重，但今晚的主角，是BLG！那个传说里打不破的BO5金身，到此为止。 赛前多少人还在念叨T1的BO5玄学，说这是一道跨不过去的坎，历史的惯性好像总会偏向他们。可BLG用一局一局的发挥告诉所有人，玄学是用来打破的，纪录是用来改写的。不再是惜败的剧本，不再是差一口气的遗憾，从对线到团战，从决策到抓机会，每一环都顶住了考验。旧时代的神话还在发光，但新的挑战者已经站上高台，BLG，把LPL等了很久的这一场胜利，稳稳拿下来了！
top.en: 1. Who would have thought that the LPL, once suffocated by T1's [~0:BO5] curse, would have BLG tear those chains to pieces with their own hands today? How many years has it been? Every single [~0:BO5] against T1 ended in heartache, with countless near-misses and endless sighs of regret. But tonight is different—Bin stood his ground against the pressure, the whole team played solid and steady, refusing to let T1's macro pace drag them by the nose. That insurmountable mountain from the past has finally been trampled right under their feet. Faker is still fighting desperately to create plays, and legends deserve our respect, but tonight's main characters are BLG! That mythical, unbreakable [~0:BO5] plot armor stops right here. How many people were chanting T1's [~1:mystical] aura before the match, calling them an impossible hurdle, as if historical momentum always favored them. Yet BLG showed everyone game after game that [~1:mystical] auras are meant to be shattered and records are meant to be rewritten. No more tragic near-miss scripts, no more falling just a bit short. From laning phase to teamfights, from decision-making to capitalizing on openings, they held firm through every single test. The mythology of the old era still shines, but the new challengers have already stepped up to the high stage. BLG has securely claimed the victory the LPL has been waiting for for so long!

notes.context: A playoff series where the first team to win three games wins.
Used in esports to describe unexplainable superstitions, curses, or plot armor.

top.zh: 我s5入的坑一开始是UZI粉丝，s8被g2击败就基本脱粉了，我当时的群昵称从小狗梦园s6一直改到了小狗梦园s8，我也从未像某些串子诋毁过那个时期的大魔王，一直觉得他是个很强的对手而已，他的比赛我也并不关注可是自从回看了s7那个鸟巢回眸我在他的眼神里看到了那个大魔王一定会回来的，自此成为Faker的粉丝，s8s9s10s11陪Faker熬过低谷s12陪faker熬过那一日清晨最让人遗憾的失利，之后看他四年三冠，恍惚间回想起s7那一年的五选巨像将天顶，并且这一顶就是顶了9年，要记住他也是凡人啊，他也会有压力也会累，就像他说的一样这个不败纪录终将会被打破，而这一刻还请lpl新生代粉丝嘴下留情，因为我相信他已经赢得了lpl老生代粉丝的尊重，最后只能说这一胜送给s5到s8支持lpl的那个孩子，也谢谢这个老头，谢谢最值得让人尊敬的对手：Faker-李相赫！
top.en: I started playing in Season 5 and was initially a UZI fan. After getting knocked out by G2 in Season 8, I basically stopped following him. My group chat nickname back then changed all the way from Xiaogou's Dream Garden S6 to Xiaogou's Dream Garden S8, but I never joined certain [~0:trolls] in bashing the GOAT of that era, always feeling he was just a very strong opponent. I didn't pay much attention to his matches either, but ever since rewatching that S7 Bird's Nest glance back, I saw in his eyes that the GOAT would definitely return. Ever since then, I became a Faker fan. Seasons 8, 9, 10, and 11 accompanied Faker through his slump, and Season 12 accompanied Faker through that most regrettable defeat on that morning. Afterwards, I watched him win three championships in four years, and in a daze, I recalled that S7 year of Galio carrying the team on his back [~1:propping up the heavens], and this prop-up has lasted for 9 years. Remember that he is also a mortal; he also has pressure and gets tired. Just as he said, this undefeated record will eventually be broken, and for this moment, I ask the new-generation LPL fans to [~2:show some mercy with your words], because I believe he has already earned the respect of the old-generation LPL fans. Finally, I can only say this win is dedicated to the kids who supported the LPL from S5 to S8, and thank you to this old man, thank you to the most respectable opponent: Faker - Lee Sanghyeok!

notes.context: Internet trolls who pretend to be fans of a team or player just to make them look bad by provoking others.
Refers to Faker's legendary performance on Galio carrying his team in S7.
Asking people not to be too harsh or toxic in their comments.

Oner, watch your [~1:Smite] 😡

top.zh:
那年四强，是RNG对阵SKT，最终比分2-3。
当时我看见小狗倒了，落寞离场，这个画面我永生难忘。
那一刻我在想，如果我站在这个舞台，我一定要替LPL拿下胜利。
两年前的决赛，我们同样战至最后一局，最后同样2-3惜败遗憾与冠军擦肩而过。
上天如今再次把机会交到我们手上，四强我们再次与T1相遇。
前辈们留下的遗憾，还有我们自己的遗憾，该由我们亲手补上。
如今再次遇上T1，我必须考虑这会不会是我此生仅有的机会。
我相信LPL一路走来的荣光，前辈们功不可没。
重铸LPL的荣光，我辈义不容辞！
